projects.title: Hits to Heartbeats
projects.description: Dua.com our biggest local dating and relationships app was set to expand globally. They asked us help them prepare for this leap, and we did it lovingly, creating a huge hype with our very first billboard in Germany.

data.content: We partnered with Dua to refresh their brand, aligning it with their mission to reduce loneliness. Our rebranding efforts helped reflect the app's focus on guiding users through the stages of love: Be The One, Find Your One, and Grow Together.

data.text: Helping Achieve a Poetic Brand with Infinite Impact

data.content: Recognizing the opportunity to elevate its brand, Dua turned to us to ensure it better reflected its commitment to celebrating cultural heritage and fostering meaningful relationships.
In our work with Dua, we added a poetic touch to their logo by incorporating timeless elements like the heart symbol, designed with the golden ratio.
This approach reflects the essence of love, with butterfly motifs representing the excitement of romance and interlocking hearts symbolizing unity.
The design also incorporates a DNA chain, reflecting deep connections and, from a different perspective, forms an infinity symbol to highlight the endless possibilities of enduring love.

Dua faced backlash when one of our billboard campaigns, promoting love aligned with heritage and personal preferences, was criticized for appearing exclusionary. However, Twitter users quickly rallied behind the message, celebrating cultural identity in relationships.
This shift generated over 8 million views, transforming the controversy into a powerful affirmation of Dua’s mission, and sparking meaningful conversations around love, heritage, and inclusivity.
At the Sunny Hill Festival, we seized a major opportunity to elevate Dua’s presence by designing striking visual materials, including branded merchandise, stickers, and interactive games.

We notably created butterfly wings that aligned with Dua’s new logo, symbolizing infinite love. Festival-goers eagerly engaged with these elements, which left a lasting impression and significantly expanded Dua’s reach.
